title: Bare overview lists superseded run_* runs with no epic id and an empty resume
body:
`ticfac` at a 120-column tty lists six earlier runs of hn6 (run_6d88, run_d51a, run_09eb, run_37b3, run_3f03, run_ee8e) beside the live epic-hn6. Their models carry epic_id '' (their records are not found from the checkout), so markOverviewHistory cannot mark them superseded, and their clearing commands lose the epic: 'clear with: ticfac run-epic ' (nothing after it) and 'ticfac settle  yjq 12 --run-id …' (double space). Their first line is unbounded (325, 788, 1225, 2488, 2792 characters at width 120) and the failed ones say 'it needs a person' above 'needs you: nothing'. The headline the epic adopted is right; the rows around it are not. Resolve the epic for a registered run_* id (its checkpoint names it), never print a command with an empty operand, and bound the state line to the width.
evidence: internal/cli/overview.go:388 (rows with EpicID == "" never enter `latest`), internal/statusmodel/commands.go:28-32 ResumeCommand(host, ""); `ticfac status run_09ebaf290f934172912b00bd112d8e06 --json` -> epic_id ""
